SummerExitStageLeftBanner.png|{{Color|Beach|Surfs Up}} skin on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} SummerExitStageLeftUpdateIcon.png|{{Color|Beach|Surfs Up}} skin on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Development}} SurfsUpWarlockDG.gif|{{Color|Beach|Surfs Up}} skin on a development gif. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} DragonWarlockCA.png|{{Color|Premium|Dragon}} skin on concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} WarlockStoreRender.png|Default skin on a render. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The default skin may be a reference to [[w:c:berserk:Guts|Guts]] from ''Berserk''. *The {{Color|Showtime|Rockstar}} skin is a submission modeled by [https://twitter.com/SoupedGun SoupedGun]. **The concept art for the skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/5384420440/profile Joe0w44]. **The skin was heavily inspired by [https://deltarune.wiki/w/Susie Susie] from the game ''Deltarune'', a mix of the fashion of Punk and with the general idea of rockstars in the 70s. **Its weapon took a lot of inspiration from [[w:c:adventuretime:Marceline|Marceline]]'s Axe Guitar from the show ''Adventure Time'', as well as [https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Axe The Axe] from the game ''Terraria''. **"''Warlocks Rule''" is a reference to "''Wizards Rule''", a phrase in ''Adventure Time'' that unlocks the entrance to the [[w:c:adventuretime:Wizard City|Wizard City]]. **The {{Color|Showtime|Rockstar}} skin had to have its arm amputated in the past, resulting in its unusual appearance. ***The part of the amputated arm that still remains has less muscles on it. This was done to make it match up with what real amputees typically have. *The {{Color|Beach|Surfs Up}} skin was made by null while the concept art was made by Loonimoff.https://x.com/NullNotMe3006/status/2096047496585941079 *The {{Color|Premium|Dragon}} skin was made by Linx.https://x.com/LinxtheDev/status/2100979537207042349 *The {{Color|Premium|Dragon}} skin is missing a wing and is blind in one eye, apparently caused by some injury.[[File:DragonWarlockProof1.png|400px]]
